exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Elegant variation and abstract nouns

items.prompt: We signed the deal on Friday, and the ___ was announced to the market on Monday.
His patience impressed the board; such ___ is rare in a high-stakes negotiation.
items.hintAfterError: Substantivo abstrato que começa com 're-' e significa autocontrole.

items.prompt: The conversation lasted three hours, and the ___ ended with a handshake.
Her brilliance was obvious; the board admired her commercial ___.
items.hintAfterError: Palavra formal para perspicácia nos negócios.

items.prompt: The pressure was enormous, and the ___ showed on every face at the table.
